description: This source file defines the TlsClientAuthenticationOptions class, which encapsulates settings for TLS client authentication, including certificate selection callback, enabled protocols, revocation check mode, and target host, wrapping around the internal SslClientAuthenticationOptions from System.Net.Security.

classes.name: TlsClientAuthenticationOptions
classes.description: Encapsulates TLS client authentication settings, wrapping an internal SslClientAuthenticationOptions instance and exposing properties for certificate selection callback, protocols, revocation mode, and target host.

methods.name: LocalCertificateSelectionCallback (getter and setter)
methods.description: Gets or sets the callback used for selecting local client certificates during TLS authentication.

methods.name: ClientCertificates
methods.description: Gets or sets the collection of client certificates used for authentication.

methods.name: EnabledSslProtocols
methods.description: Gets or sets the SSL/TLS protocols enabled for the connection.

methods.name: CertificateRevocationCheckMode
methods.description: Gets or sets the revocation mode used to check certificate revocation status.

methods.name: TargetHost
methods.description: Gets or sets the hostname of the server to evaluate the certificate trust.

methods.name: SslClientAuthenticationOptions
methods.description: Returns the internal SslClientAuthenticationOptions object used internally.
